decisions.decision: Build a reusable project-local skill with brand profiles rather than a Cinco-only script.
decisions.reason: The repository is intended to hold multiple Blotato automations, while Cinco H Ranch is the first concrete profile and test case.
The user wants generation quality proven first and has prohibited use of currently connected social accounts.

decisions.decision: Treat reference editing as template-dependent and fail closed when the live schema does not expose a source-image input.
decisions.reason: Blotato lists Nano Banana edit models publicly but does not document a universal reference-image request contract.

decisions.decision: Require human approval between image generation and video animation.
decisions.reason: Animation can amplify label, product, and identity distortion while consuming substantially more credits.
